title: The Hard Asset
author: Oscar Nystrom
blurb: Isandro Eriksen, a hostage negotiator with one failure still on the board, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. But when a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must burn the network that did the training before the border checkpoint shifts change.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
